svg.title: Matsvei Kavalenka · AI Engineer
svg.desc: A hard court seen from above, with a ball landing deep by the baseline. Focus: reinforcement learning, fine-tuning, multi-agent systems, PoCs. Below it, a rally across a net, one stage per shot, from idea to PoC: scope the problem and metric, prototype a quick PoC on real data, fine-tune the base model, reinforce with rewards, orchestrate multi-agent systems, evaluate and iterate. Then the loadout. Languages: Python, Java. Gen AI: RAG, GraphRAG, LangChain, Langfuse, TensorFlow. Data stores: Qdrant, Neo4j, FalkorDB, Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB. Cloud and ops: Azure, GCP, Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform. Data engineering: Apache Spark, Kafka, Spark SQL, ETL/ELT. Drills, from the AI_notes repo (41 notebooks): LangChain 15, NLP 10, LangGraph 6, LLMs 4, vector databases 3, speech 2, LLM apps 1. Match play, selected repos: ML-Algorithms, Clustering-Analysis, data_classification_heart_disease, Multilayer_Perceptron_Learning.
